title: A test extension of topk-router: its default rule in one fused selection, the rest topk-router's
description: topk-router subclassed, not copied: its options (extends), its host reference and every rule but one are topk-router's own code; the default rule (softmax over the selected logits, no groups, bias or renormalization) selects by one top-k over keys that order the logits as topk-router's stable sort does (NaN below -inf, ties to the lower id). For crit_plugins.compose's tests, in an engine that holds topk-router where crit plugins add puts it.

fused.description: the default rule through the fused selection; false: topk-router's
